contracts.source_contract: Every actual gm word is initialized, canonical, and equals R*h^E(i) in ZMod p, R=2^31 and h=g^2. Exact unscaled root order is a conclusion. The complete parsed body is consumed, including inverse-table calls and stores.
contracts.rows: For k=0..9 and physical j in row k: E(2^k+j)=c(k)*(3*bitrev(k,j)+1+bitrev(k,j)%2), c(9)=1 and c(k)=3*2^(8-k) for k<9. E(0)=E(1). Orders: row9=4608, rows0..8=6*2^k, index0=6.
contracts.alias: The pinned caller pointer-alias chain is executed. ft/gt/Ft/Gt have 1536 words each; gm has 1024 words, starts at word6144. igm aliases the first1024 words of ft. Table extents4096 bytes, coefficient extents6144 bytes, required total28672 bytes. Pairwise output/table separation and allocated cells are kernel consequences.
contracts.overwrite: source_then_overwrite composes the table execution with the actual coefficient-conversion execution through their equal heap, explicit caller local/pointer bindings, legal separate input objects and the original material witness. It concludes the same gm rows and same original four Vec arrays after overwrite.
contracts.preservation: Original bytes outside the caller scratch object, including same-block disjoint subobjects, are preserved through generator writes and conversion. REV10 is readonly and preserved.
contracts.boundary: Function-entry memory/arguments/static initialization and cross-call heap/bindings are explicit local interfaces. Whole allocator/caller/KeyGen assembly belongs to B1.07. No modp_div inverse-value theorem, NTT evaluation, t*m=n, compiler correctness, emitted-to-fiber theorem or independent review is claimed.
